title: Non-anchor position period prediction v24
rationale: This lane predeclares an absolute-position period rule before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because it does not use public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate words, routed key-material results, held-out anchor controls, or prior public-fragment structure screens as discovery evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should fall into one or more registered period residue classes at a rate exceeding seeded null and best-of-period controls before any candidate-word, route, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set emitted by the position-period prediction-plan command family
Residue-class rule fixed before adding or scoring any new source-backed observations
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale
Observation archives validated before period scoring and not derived from public known-plaintext anchor fragments
controls: seeded shuffle baseline over non-anchor K4 positions
multiple-comparison correction across registered periods and residue classes
